title: How parenthood contributes to gender gaps in academia
notes: n.a. (SOURCES.md has no key number; author attribution MISMATCH: not Derrick et al.). Survey of 7,764 academics: gender gaps appear in the parent group only. Mothers vs fathers: OR 0.72 (95% CI 0.63-0.82) for satisfaction with research achievements, OR 1.31 (1.19-1.45) for higher work-family conflict; non-parents show no significant gap (OR 1.05 for conflict).
